articles.artkey.desc: A BIGSERIAL primary key identifying each article (e.g., 10001)

articles.catlabel.desc: An enum (articlecategory_enum) for article category (Entertainment, Business, Sports, News, Technology)

articles.subcatlbl.desc: An enum (articlesubcategory_enum) for article subcategory (International, Opinion, Local, Feature)

articles.pubtime.desc: A TIMESTAMP for when the article was published (e.g., '2025-02-10 08:00:00')

articles.authname.desc: A VARCHAR(200) capturing the article’s author (e.g., 'John Smith')

articles.srcref.desc: A VARCHAR(150) referencing the article source or publication name (e.g., 'Reuters')

articles.wordlen.desc: An INT for the article's word count (e.g., 1200)

articles.readsec.desc: An INT measuring the estimated reading time in seconds (e.g., 300)

articles.difflevel.desc: An enum (articledifficultylevel_enum) describing the reading complexity (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced)

articles.freshscore.desc: A NUMERIC(5,2) measuring how fresh or recent the content is (e.g., 65.50)

articles.qualscore.desc: A NUMERIC(5,2) capturing an overall quality rating (e.g., 80.00)

articles.contrscore.desc: A NUMERIC(5,2) measuring controversy level (e.g., 10.50 = low controversy)

articles.tagset.desc: A TEXT field listing associated tags/keywords (e.g., 'politics, election')

articles.conttype.desc: An enum (contenttype_enum) describing the article's content type (Article, Gallery, Video, Interactive)

articles.contformat.desc: An enum (contentformat_enum) specifying format (Mobile, Text, HTML, AMP)

articles.accscore.desc: A NUMERIC(5,2) referencing accessibility or ease-of-use score (e.g., 90.00)

articles.mediacount.desc: An INT indicating how many media elements (images, videos) are included (e.g., 3)

articles.vidsec.desc: An INT measuring video duration in seconds if it's a video-based article (e.g., 120)

articles.paywall.desc: An enum (paywallstatus_enum) describing paywall status (Metered, Premium, Free)

articles.authref.desc: A BIGINT FK referencing Users(UserKey) if the author is also a user in the system

articles.engagement_metrics.desc: JSONB column. Aggregates metrics related to article engagement and performance, such as popularity, engagement rate, and social interactions

devices.devkey.desc: A BIGSERIAL primary key uniquely identifying a device (e.g., 501)

devices.devtype.desc: An enum (devicetype_enum) describing device OS type (iOS, Windows, MacOS, Android)

devices.brwtype.desc: An enum (browsertype_enum) referencing the browser used (Safari, Edge, Chrome, Firefox)

devices.osver.desc: A VARCHAR(40) capturing the specific OS version (e.g., 'Windows10.0.19042')

devices.appver.desc: A VARCHAR(20) for the app version if used (e.g., 'v3.1.2')

devices.vpsize.desc: A VARCHAR(15) describing the viewport size in the browser/app (e.g., '414x896')

devices.conntype.desc: An enum (connectiontype_enum) for the network type (Cable, 5G, 4G, WiFi)

devices.netspd.desc: A NUMERIC(6,2) measuring network speed in Mbps (e.g., 25.75)

devices.uselink.desc: A BIGINT FK linking to Users(UserKey) to show which user owns or uses this device

interactionmetrics.intmetkey.desc: A BIGINT primary key referencing Interactions(IntKey)

interactionmetrics.interaction_behavior.desc: JSONB column. Captures user interaction behavior metrics, including scroll depth, time spent, and conversion details

interactions.intkey.desc: A BIGSERIAL primary key for each interaction record (e.g., 7001)

interactions.artval.desc: A BIGINT storing the article ID related to the interaction (non-FK)

interactions.intts.desc: A TIMESTAMP capturing when the interaction occurred (e.g., '2025-04-01 10:15:00')

interactions.evttype.desc: An enum (eventtype_enum) describing the event (bookmark, click, scroll, share, view)

interactions.seqval.desc: An INT for the event's sequence or position in the session (e.g., 3)

interactions.agentval.desc: An enum (useragent_enum) describing the user agent (Desktop, App, Mobile, Tablet)

interactions.clkts.desc: A TIMESTAMP specifically for when a click event happened (if applicable)

interactions.clkpos.desc: An enum (clickposition_enum) capturing the click position (1–10)

interactions.clktype.desc: An enum (clicktype_enum) describing type of click (Related, Trending, Direct, Recommended)

interactions.clksrc.desc: An enum (clicksource_enum) referencing where the click originated (Article, Homepage, Search, External)

interactions.clkctx.desc: An enum (clickcontext_enum) capturing context of the click (Headline, Summary, Image, Author)

interactions.inttype.desc: An enum (interactiontype_enum) describing the type of user interaction (Scroll, Share, Click, Hover)

recommendations.reckey.desc: A BIGSERIAL primary key for recommendation records (e.g., 3001)

recommendations.alglabel.desc: An enum (recalgorithm_enum) describing the recommendation algorithm (Contextual, Content-based, Collaborative, Hybrid)

recommendations.stratlabel.desc: An enum (recstrategy_enum) capturing strategy used (Trending, Editorial, Similar, Personalized)

recommendations.posval.desc: An INT for the recommendation position or rank in a list (e.g., 3)

recommendations.recpage.desc: An enum (recpage_enum) describing where the recommendation is displayed (Search, Category, Home, Article)

recommendations.recsec.desc: An enum (recsection_enum) describing the section used for recommendation (Bottom, Sidebar, Related, Top)

recommendations.recscore.desc: A NUMERIC(5,2) capturing the recommendation relevance or ranking score (e.g., 85.40)

recommendations.divval.desc: A NUMERIC(5,2) rating how diverse the recommendation is (e.g., 20.00)

recommendations.artlink.desc: A BIGINT FK referencing Articles(ArtKey), linking recommended article with the recommendation record

sessions.seshkey.desc: A BIGSERIAL primary key for session records (e.g., 401)

sessions.userel.desc: A BIGINT FK referencing Users(UserKey) to link the session to a user

sessions.devrel.desc: A BIGINT FK referencing Devices(DevKey) to link the session to a device

sessions.seshstart.desc: A TIMESTAMP indicating when the session started (e.g., '2025-03-12 14:00:00')

sessions.seshdur.desc: An INT capturing the session's total duration in seconds (e.g., 1200 = 20 minutes)

sessions.seshviews.desc: An INT counting how many pages/articles the user viewed in this session (e.g., 5)

sessions.bncrate.desc: A NUMERIC(5,2) measuring the bounce rate for the session (e.g., 25.00)

sessions.seshdepth.desc: An INT measuring how deep the user navigated (e.g., 3 screens)

sessions.seshrecs.desc: An INT indicating how many recommendations were shown to the user (e.g., 10)

sessions.seshclicks.desc: An INT counting how many recommendation clicks occurred (e.g., 2)

sessions.ctrval.desc: A NUMERIC(5,2) capturing the click-through rate for recommendations (e.g., 20.00)

sessions.langcode.desc: An enum (languagecode_enum) describing the user's language (fr, es, en, de, zh)

sessions.tzoffset.desc: An enum (timezoneoffset_enum) for the user’s time zone offset (8, 1, 0, -5, -8)

sessions.ipaddr.desc: An INET column storing the user's IP address (e.g., '192.168.0.10')

sessions.geoctry.desc: A VARCHAR(100) referencing the user’s country based on IP geo (e.g., 'USA')

sessions.georeg.desc: A VARCHAR(100) referencing the user’s region or state (e.g., 'California')

sessions.geocity.desc: A VARCHAR(100) referencing the user’s city (e.g., 'San Francisco')

sessions.expref.desc: A VARCHAR(30) referencing an experiment ID or tag (e.g., 'EXP123')

sessions.persver.desc: An enum (personalizationversion_enum) for personalization system version (v4, v1, v3, v2, v5)

sessions.recset.desc: A VARCHAR(50) referencing a recommendation set ID if used (e.g., 'RecSetXYZ')

sessions.relscore.desc: A NUMERIC(5,2) capturing overall content relevance (e.g., 75.50)

sessions.recutil.desc: A NUMERIC(5,2) measuring recommendation utility or value (e.g., 70.25)

systemperformance.rectrace.desc: A BIGSERIAL primary key for system performance records (e.g., 501)

systemperformance.perfts.desc: A TIMESTAMP capturing when this system performance record was logged

systemperformance.resptime.desc: An INT measuring system response time in milliseconds (e.g., 120)

systemperformance.errcount.desc: An enum (errorcount_enum) capturing how many errors occurred (0–5)

systemperformance.cachestate.desc: An enum (cachestatus_enum) describing cache usage (Hit, Expired, Miss)

systemperformance.apiver.desc: An enum (apiversion_enum) for the API version (v3, v2, v1)

systemperformance.cliver.desc: A VARCHAR(50) storing the client version if relevant (e.g., 'web-1.2')

systemperformance.featset.desc: A TEXT field for feature flags or toggles (e.g., 'newUI, improvedSearch')

systemperformance.devlink.desc: A BIGINT referencing Devices(DevKey), linking performance data to a device

systemperformance.seshlink.desc: A BIGINT referencing Sessions(SeshKey), linking performance data to a session

users.userkey.desc: A BIGSERIAL primary key for each user in the system (e.g., 1001)

users.regmoment.desc: A DATE indicating when the user registered (e.g., '2024-05-10')

users.typelabel.desc: An enum (usertype_enum) representing the user type (Trial, Premium, Free)

users.seglabel.desc: An enum (usersegment_enum) describing the user's segment (New, Dormant, Active, Regular)

users.substatus.desc: An enum (subscriptionstatus_enum) indicating subscription status (Premium, Enterprise, Basic)

users.subdays.desc: An INT specifying how many days the user has been subscribed (e.g., 60)

users.ageval.desc: An INT capturing the user's age in years (e.g., 30)

users.gendlbl.desc: An enum (usergender_enum) for the user's gender (M, F, Other)

users.occulbl.desc: An enum (useroccupation_enum) describing the user's occupation (Retired, Professional, Other, Student)

users.testgrp.desc: An enum (abtestgroup_enum) labeling which A/B test group the user belongs to (Control, Variant_A, Variant_B)

users.user_preferences.desc: JSONB column. Stores user-related preferences and feedback details, including interests, activity level, and satisfaction metrics

relations.result: clicks out of recommendations shown, count
